title: Best AI Tools for Researchers

content:
## Research is where AI can be genuinely helpful

AI tools can reduce the time spent collecting and organizing information, especially when the task is repetitive or broad. They are also useful for turning a large amount of source material into a cleaner summary or outline.

## Best practices

- Check source quality
- Distinguish between summary and fact
- Keep a trail of evidence
- Validate claims before publishing or citing

## Final takeaway

AI is powerful for accelerating discovery, but research quality still depends on careful reading, evaluation, and evidence checking.
